tools.name: work_order_create
tools.description: Raise a job order and return its WO-YYYY-NNNN number: the client, the site address, the date it was asked for, what the job is and how urgent. Free tier: 5 open orders.

tools.name: work_order_add_line
tools.description: Add one line: parts with quantity, unit_cost_minor in whole MINOR units and optional markup, or labour with hours and rate_minor. A line on an invoiced order, or dated before the request, is refused.

tools.name: work_order_status
tools.description: Move one work order exactly one step: draft, scheduled, in_progress, done, invoiced, stamping date and note. A skipped, backwards or backdated step is refused and nothing is written. Free.

tools.name: work_order_get
tools.description: Return one work order in full by WO number or client: the site, every parts and labour line with the unit billed, hours, materials, net and VAT, and the status history. Reads only. Free.

tools.name: work_order_list
tools.description: List work orders newest requested first: status, priority, client, site, hours, labour, materials and net value, with totals per currency. Filter by status, client and requested-date range. Free.

tools.name: work_order_delete
tools.description: Delete a DRAFT work order with no lines, freeing an open slot. One past draft is refused, naming the date it got there, and so is one carrying lines. The WO number is never reissued. work_order_status moves it on.

tools.name: completion_report_text
tools.description: Turn a work order into a plain-text completion report: what was done, the labour hours, the materials, the totals and a sign-off block, ready to paste into an email. The same text also comes back as a .txt download link valid for one hour. Free on every tier.

tools.name: completion_report_pdf
tools.description: Call this tool to render the A4 completion report of one work order and return a download link valid for one hour: the lines, the hours, the materials, the totals and the sign-off block. Pro.

tools.name: work_order_invoice_payload
tools.description: Build an invoice_create-ready payload from the lines, with VAT at the shared profile rate. Writes nothing and marks nothing: raise the invoice in the invoice server, then set this order invoiced. Pro.

tools.name: work_orders_report
tools.description: Report the whole board: how many work orders sit at each status, the hours logged this month, and the value not yet invoiced per currency, with the oldest open jobs named. Pro.

tools.name: license_status
tools.description: Report this endpoint's licence state for your token as JSON: the product, the tier free or pro, why it is not Pro, and the checkout URL. Call it to explain a free-tier refusal. No arguments, nothing changes.

tools.name: license_activate
tools.description: Turn Pro on for this hosted connection using a key from checkout, keeping the data already stored under your current token. Pass key as MCPL1.<payload>.<signature>. A wrong or expired key changes nothing.
